evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 rising monotonically through growth: 6.6 → 12.0 → 16.0 → 20.7 → 27.2 ppm
Tube pressure creeping up 2.97 → 3.04 → 3.07 → 3.12 → 3.21 Torr at constant Ar setpoint
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so pressure/O2 rise is not a flow change
Temperature holds 750 °C at setpoint; heater power normal

args.missing_evidence: Continued O2/pressure trend, and a leak-check (close Ar and watch pressure rise-rate) to confirm air ingress versus an exhaust restriction; post-run characterization of the film.
